content: react-native-mmkv latest is 4.3.2, a Nitro Module requiring react-native-nitro-modules peer and RN 0.76+; V3 required new architecture explicitly. Expo: npx expo install + prebuild; custom native C++ means Expo Go unsupported, dev build required. No config plugin exists or is needed. Encryption: createMMKV({encryptionKey, encryptionType}) - default AES-128, opt-in AES-256; recrypt() re-keys. No official expo-secure-store key helper in v3/v4 docs - DIY async key load required before synchronous instance creation. JSI sync calls: remote Chrome debugging impossible; all reads/writes synchronous on JS thread.
